question_line: One question for every RERA phase in Gurugram: will the OC arrive more than 12 months late?

bands.label: Low
bands.sentence: Between 5 and 15 of 100 similar Gurugram projects got their OC more than 12 months after the original RERA date.

bands.label: Moderate
bands.sentence: Between 15 and 30 of 100 similar Gurugram projects got their OC more than 12 months after the original RERA date.

bands.label: Elevated
bands.sentence: Between 30 and 45 of 100 similar Gurugram projects got their OC more than 12 months after the original RERA date.

bands.label: High
bands.sentence: Between 45 and 65 of 100 similar Gurugram projects got their OC more than 12 months after the original RERA date.

bands.label: Severe
bands.sentence: Between 65 and 80 of 100 similar Gurugram projects got their OC more than 12 months after the original RERA date.

bands_note_line: Ranges are provisional until our first calibration backtest is published.
similar_line: Gurugram RERA phases registered 2017–2021, of comparable size, by developers with a comparable number of finished projects.

late12.line: Whether a phase gets its OC more than 12 months after its original RERA date. We call this Late12.
late12.extensions_line: We add extensions given to every project, such as COVID and the 4-month MoHUA extension of Jul 2026. We don't add extensions granted to one project. Those are part of the delay we predict.

example.line: Original completion Dec 2027. More than 12 months late here means an OC after Apr 2029, with the 4-month blanket extension of Jul 2026.
example.oc_not_keys_line: The OC is not the keys. Possession comes after it: the developer offers it, you pay the last 5% and register the sale deed.

factors_note_line: These are starting weights. We refit them after each backtest and publish the change.
how_line: Red-flag rules come first. Then an interpretable scorecard adds up the five groups. Each score lists up to 4 reasons, ranked by how much they moved it. No AI ever sets a score.

red_flag_rules.title: Insolvency (CIRP) admitted against the promoter or a group company
red_flag_rules.line: The band is Severe while the case stands.

red_flag_rules.title: RERA registration revoked, de-registered or lapsed without an extension
red_flag_rules.line: Applies from the day HARERA records the revocation, or the day a registration lapses with no extension.

red_flag_rules.title: A stop-sale or abeyance order from the regulator
red_flag_rules.line: Applies while the order stands. When it is lifted, the model's band returns and the change is logged.

red_flag_rules.title: The promoter group is rated D or is in default
red_flag_rules.line: We quote the rating agency's own symbol and date, exactly as published.

red_flag_example_line: Example: Laurel Residency, Sector 92. A group company of Elmstone Developers was admitted to insolvency by NCLT order of 12 Mar 2023.

confidence.line: We're more certain about this one. Many comparable finished projects, in Gurugram and in this group, so the range we show is narrow.
We're less certain about this one. Fewer comparable projects, so we show a wider range. The uncertain part is hatched.
Not enough history to score · no penalty. We score a group once it has 3 finished RERA projects.
Not scored: we always say why on the card, for example registered less than 6 months ago.

data_rules.line: We recompute within 72 hours of a new filing or order. Data more than 120 days old gets a stale flag.

versions.title: Blanket extensions added to every original date
items: The 4-month MoHUA extension of Jul 2026 is now added to every original RERA date before we measure Late12.
Extensions granted to a single project are still not added. They are part of what we predict.
The stale flag now shows when a key input is more than 120 days old, down from 180.
versions.note: Approved by the methodology committee on 9 Oct 2026. Every band was recalculated on 14 Oct 2026.

versions.title: Tighter QPR checks and group linking
items: A QPR whose built share falls from the last quarter now counts as a filing problem.
Group companies are linked by common directors and shareholding, using MCA data from a licensed vendor.
versions.note: Approved by the methodology committee on 26 Aug 2026.

versions.title: First public bands for Gurugram
items: Five bands with natural frequencies, up to 4 sourced reasons, and a developer reply on every card.
Replaced v0.9, which published facts only, with no bands.
versions.note: Approved by the methodology committee on 8 Jul 2026.

never_line: No developer pays us. Ever. And no one can pay to change, hide, delay or preview a score.

meta.disclaimer_line: Our opinion, based on public records. Not a credit rating. Not issued by any RERA.
